analyst_view.overall: Third-placed Inter (29 pts, three behind leaders Lazio) host Genoa (10th, 16 pts) on Saturday evening; the numbers make Inter clear favourites with about 3.1 goals. Cristian Chivu's side drew at Atalanta last weekend and face a Champions League game they need to win against Stuttgart at San Siro on Wednesday, so they get only three days before Genoa, a turnaround the numbers do not count. Inter have lost Hakan Calhanoglu (hamstring strain, about a month out, confirmed by Calciomercato.it and ANSA), and Piotr Zielinski and Ange-Yoan Bonny are also out; the numbers list no Inter absentees. Daniele De Rossi's Genoa have won four of their last five and beat Sassuolo on Sunday, but lost forward Lorenzo Colombo to a torn cruciate ligament (one goal this season). No referee is named yet.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.1 goals, 2.2 of them for Inter. I lean a little lower to about 2.9: Inter are without Calhanoglu, their playmaker and set-piece and penalty taker, plus Zielinski and Bonny, none of which the numbers know about, and they play three days after a must-win Champions League game. Genoa's good run under De Rossi is already in the numbers (+0.8% for their scoring), and Colombo's loss is small for their goals.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.7 corners, 6.6 for Inter, already raised for Inter's busy recent corner count (+5.4%) and lowered for Genoa's (-4.3%). Inter's wing-backs Dimarco and the right-side option still drive most of their corners whoever plays in midfield, and Genoa usually sit in a back three, so nothing new points either way and I stay at about 9.7.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.1 cards, already lowered because both sides have been booked less than usual lately (about -9% each). No referee is named yet and there is no sign of a heated game: Genoa are clear of the relegation zone and this is no derby. I stay at 3.1.

shots.text: The numbers say 30.1 shots, already lifted for Inter's heavy recent shooting (+15.8%). I trim a little to about 29.2: without Calhanoglu and Zielinski Inter lose their two main long-range shooters and midfield passers, and Chivu is likely to rotate after Wednesday's Champions League game. The lean is small because Inter still have Lautaro, Thuram and Esposito available.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.4 shots on target, 6.6 for Inter, already raised for their recent accuracy (+5.8%). For the same reasons as shots (Calhanoglu, Zielinski and Bonny out, a three-day turnaround) I go a little lower to about 9.1. Genoa's attack lost Colombo, but he was mostly a substitute, so their side changes little.
